releaseNotes:
IKSHOVIA v3.0 Official Production Release (Build 9) with Permanent Signing Identity.

• Complete Phase 1, Phase 2, and Phase 3 unified learning intelligence platform.
• Unified Prelims → Mains → Interview Preparation Engine.
• Personalized Study Planner with syllabus-linked schedules & dynamic completion queues.
• SM-2 Smart Revision Engine with deterministic interval tracking & retention curves.
• Topic & Concept Mastery Engine powered by real question attempt telemetry.
• Current Affairs Intelligence linking real-time news to syllabus themes and PYQs.
• Mains Answer Improvement Loop with multi-attempt trajectory and rubric breakdown.
• Cross-stage learner analytics and personalized AI Tutor context.
• Verified in-place upgrade from v2.2 Build 8 under permanent signing key.
